sections.kicker: Prepared for Dos Mil by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Dos Mil has a mark worth remembering. Its words never say what the label is.
sections.keep: The photography: grain, flash and stairwells. It looks like its own city at night.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The bio has only a web address, and five of nine captions repeat it.
pins.why: Nothing says in words what Dos Mil makes, where it is from or why it matters.
pins.how: Add one line to the bio that says what Dos Mil is and where it comes from.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: People who find the brand cannot repeat what it is.

pins.what: The site's menu says Twoface and the Instagram says Dos Mil.
pins.why: Two names for one label, and DOSMIL also appears in captions.
pins.how: Choose which name leads and make the other a collection name.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Fans cannot tell which name to search or say.

pins.area: The two faces mark above the menu on the site
pins.what: The two faces mark runs through the avatar, the site header and the red patch on the navy jersey.
pins.why: A mark that recognizable is rare for a clothing label and sets Dos Mil apart in a streetwear grid.
pins.how: Use it as the signature on every post and product page.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Without the signature the label blends in.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Dos Mil. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Three things stood out.
